digest.component_or_area: LLM framework: provider seam and support tier policy
propositions: The LLM provider seam is implemented via pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook as a per-run SESSION object, not a bare function, with builder bodies in leaf modules and registry/call sites centralized in providers.py.

Capability decisions read ModelProfile only (never provider-name strings), derived from field presence rather than concrete type, to avoid breaking the stdlib-only import contract and CI compatibility.

Two support tiers (first_class for native Anthropic/Bedrock builders vs best_effort for intermediaries) are determined by explicit configuration (base_url) and gateway membership, not provider registry membership, with verdicts signed on every tier and stamped with provider_provenance.
Provider seam rejects five named alternatives: LiteLLM in-process SDK, gateway-fronted Bedrock, refusing off-tier verdicts, long-term SSM API keys, and cross-provider fallback to direct Anthropic.

docs/llm-framework.md provider-resolution section is incomplete/contradicted by code: it omits rebar's provider registry interception, Bedrock support, tier definitions, and the actual tier determination logic (base_url + gateway membership).

Every runnable command in docs/llm-framework.md must be executed and produce documented results, with per-class env-var routing and local OpenAI-compatible server examples requiring verification against live behavior.
